## Current objective
Continue optimizing `ledgerly/reports/invoice_summary.py` after replacing nested per-currency invoice queries with one aggregate query per account. The dunning scheduler objective is superseded.

## Key identifiers and corrections
Tenant test account: `73`; 14,802 invoice aggregates. Report context: `account_id`, `date_from`, `date_to`. Pagination schema uses `{items, total, limit, offset}`. CI pool and router details are not currently relevant.

## Ruled-out approaches
- Nested `Invoice.objects.filter(...)` queries inside currency/tenant loops: caused 2,431–2,417 SQL statements and ~38–39 seconds; superseded by aggregation.
- No other approaches ruled out.

## Plan and progress
- [done] Inspect and profile invoice summary.
- [done] Move filtering/aggregation outside currency loops.
- [pending] Run report tests and verify query reduction.
- [pending] Review diff and formatting.
Next: `pytest -q tests/reports/test_invoice_summary.py --durations=10`

## Recent work
Pagination tests passed (3), broader invoice tests passed (18), and report tests passed before the optimization. The optimization edit is applied but not yet validated; its command result is status unknown.
